{"reason": "8 failure rows (amounts 45k-254k) had market-mismatch=#t, truth=demand-forecast-error, v1=unknown; 3 more had bias-amount 0.065-0.081 just under the 0.1 gate. Extended the forecast branch with market-signal-mismatch? and lowered the bias threshold to 0.06, converting unknowns into recovered demand-forecast-error claims.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06))
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
